text: *(Alternate version) In the year 1721 an ancient English treasure was found close to Mosfell. The treasure had been washed out after a flood. This description can be found in an article by the antiquarian Jón Ólafsson from Grunnavík. It is likely that Jón the Grunnavikian had heard about the farmer finding the treasure that the water of the ravine delivered to him.
